music.reason: Analytic chord/percussion surrogate; no music recording or listening score.

pause_or_filler_timing.reason: No pause/filler policy or source-timestamped playback decision is installed.

playback_buffering.reason: No target playback path, pacing or buffer-occupancy telemetry in this fixture.

unfamiliar_speech_preservation.reason: Analytic speech-like surrogate only; no real or unfamiliar speech cohort.
